title: Constraints with CMB lensing on dark matter decays to massive decay products (Bencke, Lee, Kamionkowski)
efc_relevance: Decaying-dark-matter (DDM) parameterised by (f, Γ, ε) fit with CLASSIER-DDM to address the DESI-vs-Planck ~5% late-time matter-density gap. Competing mechanism to EFC's L2→L3 entropic-flow explanation of the same gap: DDM produces a warm-component injection while EFC reshapes the density-stiffness K(ρ). Direct head-to-head on CMB lensing + DESI DR2 BAO posterior.
ledger_action: Add to WP3 competitor-landscape table as DDM competitor for the late-time matter-density gap; cross-reference arXiv:2503.14738 (DESI DR2) and arXiv:2504.20038 (joint CMB-lensing); required ΔAIC row vs EFC on Planck + ACT + SPT + DESI DR2 BAO + CMB-lensing.
